value.rationale: Natural uniformly distributed relaxation-rate memory yields a positive completely monotone kernel. The all-order nonnegative-weight property controls preservation of the positivity cone under arbitrary causal discrete convolution. The theorem gives an exact necessary-and-sufficient step-size boundary depending only on the slowest relaxation rate, even with an arbitrarily large fastest rate; beyond it the violation recurs infinitely often. Neither a routine stability estimate nor an arbitrary numerical sample.
